Keep the measured index / broad-momentum beta add STOOD DOWN — the leader reclaim is still missing (SPMO below ~150.6) and breadth persistence is still only two completed bars, so re-stage only on a COMPLETED close that keeps breadth above 60%, holds SPY above the 772.87 flip in positive gamma AND reclaims SPMO above ~150.6, sized on the x1.06 throttle. Persistence by distinct COMPLETED daily bars: broad participation above 60% printed on 8/7 (61.77%) and HELD on 8/10 (60.25%) — 2 consecutive completed bars, so today's 8/11 close is the test of whether it reaches three-bar persistence; this morning's tape is confirming but not yet a completed bar. Intraday/into-the-close risk: a close back below the 772.87 flip into the 773 put wall would flip dealers to amplifying; the official July NFP figure and 7/29 Fed statement/path remain re-pull items, the 8/11 calendar has no scheduled high-importance release, and the next scheduled item is the BLS preliminary benchmark revision 8/28.
